key.name: refresh-interval
key.summary: Fast telemetry refresh interval in seconds
key.description: Interval in seconds between fast hardware telemetry updates (CPU, GPU, RAM, Fan).

key.name: slow-refresh-interval
key.summary: Slow telemetry refresh interval in seconds
key.description: Interval in seconds between slower storage, battery capacity, and system uptime checks.

key.name: temperature-unit
key.description: Display hardware temperatures in Celsius (°C) or Fahrenheit (°F).

key.name: graph-history-length
key.description: Maximum number of historical telemetry samples retained in bounded ring buffers.

key.name: show-topbar-frequency
key.summary: Show CPU frequency in top bar
key.description: Display current average CPU frequency (GHz) next to CPU utilization in the top panel.

key.name: show-topbar-sparkline
key.summary: Show live sparkline in top bar
key.description: Display the compact live CPU utilization sparkline in the GNOME Shell top bar.

key.name: enable-animations
key.summary: Enable smooth animations and fan rotation
key.description: Enable smooth gauge transitions and proportional fan blade rotation when popup is open.

key.name: compact-layout
key.description: Collapse navigation sidebar and reduce card padding for smaller screens.

key.name: show-card-sysinfo
key.description: Display the Operating System, Host, and Kernel information card in the Overview.

key.name: show-card-cpu
key.description: Display the CPU utilization, frequency, temperature, and per-core card.

key.name: show-card-gpu
key.description: Display the GPU utilization, clock, temperature, VRAM, and power card.

key.name: show-card-memory
key.description: Display the RAM and Swap circular gauges and breakdown card.

key.name: show-card-storage
key.description: Display the mounted filesystems and partition capacity card.

key.name: show-card-battery
key.description: Display the battery charge, power rate, health, and remaining time card.

key.name: show-card-fan
key.description: Display the hardware fan RPM, rotational animation, and thermal history card.
